documented_probe: C-19c43363 (produce training output artifacts at an expected experiment data directory): the run must write config and progress data under the exact paths.experiment directory with real, matching content. The verifier deletes each hidden experiment directory, re-runs /app/train.py with a hidden config (different dataset, epochs, seed, and directory), and checks the directory is recreated with a faithful effective-config copy, a full-length finite decreasing loss list, and the model artifact.
notes: Easy: single-stage config-driven trainer with an explicit artifact contract. Small rubric weight for reasoning_depth (config-driven path handling, directory creation), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (fresh hidden configs/datasets), and quantitative_correctness (exact artifact contents). No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure.
